description: GAP-8 (bean qou-6wil, epic qou-xu6t): the FIRST actual test of the 4-body moment μ₄. Every prior per-block-weight probe in this epic ran at A=3, and GAP-7 proved A=3 data carries ZERO 4-body information — two simplex ansätze differing only in μ₄ agree on M(A) for every A<4 because the C(A,4) column vanishes (Lean QOU.MassTheory.UrsellSlotAlignment.mu4_unconstrained_below_four, sorry-free) — so the derived target μ₄ = −4.591 MeV had never been tested, as opposed to tested-and-missed. Construction is entirely internal to A=4 (⁴He, Z=2 N=2, 12 strands, H₁₂, 77 partitions): C(4,2)=6 bonds — 3 adjacent from the word (g₂,g₅,g₈) and 3 non-adjacent Birman–Ko–Lee band generators built by the same recipe GAP-3 used at A=3, generalised (carry 3j−1…3i+3, cross at 3i+2, carry back; at (i,j)=(0,2) it reproduces a_{7,3} verbatim). Flavour templates are DERIVED from ⁴He's own word — the adjacent interfaces read (1,0)=p–p, (1,−h(½−δ/4))=p–n, (1,−h)=n–n, pinning the ordering to (p,p,n,n) — not chosen. All 2⁶=64 subset traces computed, then the standard cluster ladder μ₂^(b)=g({b})−g(∅) over 6 bonds, μ₃^(t)=g(t)−Σ_{b∈t}g({b})+2g(∅) over 4 triangles, M(4)=g(all)−g(∅), μ₄=M(4)−Σμ₂−Σμ₃ — the same shape as the corpus recursion mu4=M[4]−6·mu2−4·mu3, but summed individually since the bonds are not equivalent. HEADLINE IS THE RATIO μ₄/μ₃ (target −9.752), because it is measured within one system so E₀, the y_λ normalisation and the global sign all cancel — this epic has repeatedly tripped over the c=±E₀·x convention and an absolute sign verdict would inherit that ambiguity. The H₁₂ pipeline is GUARDED before any moment is read off it: each triangle's μ₃ is re-derived both directly and via the proven identity μ₃=ΣΔ²g+Δ³g (Lean triangle_moment_decomp). VERDICT: measured μ₄/μ₃ = -1.0206 against target -9.7522; alternation REPRODUCED, |ratio| off by 9.56×. No Δ_λ, no μ fitted, no convention tuned, nothing wired.
